poseOrder: Exact row-major order 0–11: 0,1,2=shoot semantic STAR THROW, preparation with ONE small plain dark-metal throwing star connected visibly to fingers / actual throwing-hand extension and open fingertips at release / empty-hand balanced recovery; 3,4,5=deploy semantic EVADE, bounded quick step preparation / visibly low lateral advance / planted recovery, no invisibility, smoke, duplicate silhouette or streak; 6,7,8=throw semantic unarmed CQC, empty-hand close grapple preparation / physical throw follow-through without partner / recovery; 9,10,11=recover, unarmed reserve recovery stance / measured breath / upright return. The small held star appears only at preparation index0, connected to the fingers, never floating; index1 shows a real complete unobscured extended throwing hand suitable for measuring the release point. Do not draw any airborne star or separate effect.
